capabilities: Read EPUB books with highlights, deep links, and bookshelf state
Run five AI actions on text selected in the reader
Send selections, prompts, and model settings to a DeepSeek API endpoint
Show AI results in a viewport-aware result window
Store the API key in Obsidian SecretStorage
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installs manually from GitHub releases or via BRAT. Part of the README (the five AI action names) is in Chinese. The README includes a privacy and network disclosure and links to PRIVACY.md.
intentEvidence: This is an independent GPL-3.0-or-later derivative of Weave EPUB Reader 0.6.55 by Rabbit (zhuzhige).
motivation: The author forked the reader to keep its native selected-text pipeline and integrate the AI menu, DeepSeek requests, settings, and result window directly into one plugin, without DOM injection or runtime patching.
problem: The upstream Weave reader delegates its AI toolbar action to a separate Weave main plugin, so AI-assisted reading requires installing and running two plugins together.
